claim: OAI provides similar functionality to OAC but does not work for all scenarios; for example, OAI does not support dynamic requests (PUT, POST, or DELETE) to Amazon S3.

evidence.quote: CloudFront *origin access identity* (OAI) provides similar functionality as *origin access control* (OAC), but it doesn't work for all scenarios. Specifically, OAI doesn't support:
Dynamic requests (`PUT`, `POST`, or `DELETE`) to Amazon S3
